scope: One development task, one comparative pair per population; not a pilot or measured-series publication
unchanged: Token counts, missingness, settings, source/model identities, outcomes, timings, answers and provider-reported cash figures

corrected.basis: Recomputed from retained Responses input additional_tools declarations. Original digests and source-file hashes are in metadata-corrections.json; declarations are in tool-catalogues.json.
corrected.newObservationFlag: toolCatalogueObserved=true only after every request in the run yielded the same observed catalogue
corrected.rawEvidence: Original requests, observations and manifests are unchanged

omitted: Raw provider request/response identifiers and message histories
Full fetched-source snapshots and pipeline transport fixtures, retained privately pending redistribution review
effect: The shareable data reproduces numerical analysis and reported token-component arithmetic. It does not independently reproduce private request/hash correlation, source-backed quality scoring, or remote-service outputs. Quality is unscored. Captures and the earlier failed generation are retained but excluded from comparative cells.
